description: Source code for managing user equipment (UE) bearers in a 5G/NR network, including connection, disconnection, and creation of DRB (Data Radio Bearer) instances with associated F1-U and RLC entities.

classes.name: du_srb_connector
classes.description: Handles connection and disconnection of Signaling Radio Bearer (SRB) between RLC, F1-C, and MAC layers.

classes.name: du_ue_srb
classes.description: Represents a UE Signaling Radio Bearer with stop functionality.

classes.name: du_drb_connector
classes.description: Handles connection and disconnection of Data Radio Bearer (DRB) between F1-U, RLC, and MAC layers.

classes.name: du_ue_drb
classes.description: Represents a UE Data Radio Bearer with stop functionality.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes connections between RLC, F1-C, MAC, and other layers for SRB or DRB.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Terminates established connections for SRB or DRB.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the SRB or DRB, disconnecting and halting associated processes.

methods.name: create_drb
methods.description: Creates a new Data Radio Bearer (DRB) instance with associated F1-U and RLC entities based on provided configuration.
